This page lists 94 WebStorm keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `webstorm.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in WebStorm to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t webstorm.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/webstorm.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/WebStorm.app`; if WebStorm lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Search & Navigation

⇧⇧ and ⌃⌃ mean double-tap the key.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⇧` | Search Everywhere |
| `⌘⇧A` | Find Action |
| `⌃⌃` | Run Anything |
| `⌘E` | View Recent Files |
| `⇧⌘E` | View Recent Locations |
| `⌘O` | Go to Class |
| `⌘⇧O` | Go to File |
| `⌘⌥O` | Go to Symbol |
| `⌘L` | Go to Line |
| `⌘B` | Go to Declaration |
| `⌘⌥B` | Go to Implementation |
| `⌃⇧B` | Go to Type Declaration |
| `⌘U` | Go to Super Method |
| `⌘[` | Navigate Back |
| `⌘]` | Navigate Forward |
| `F2` | Next Highlighted Error |
| `⇧F2` | Previous Highlighted Error |

## Editing

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘/` | Toggle Line Comment |
| `⌘⌥/` | Toggle Block Comment |
| `⌘D` | Duplicate Line |
| `⌘⌫` | Delete Line |
| `⌥↑` | Extend Selection |
| `⌥↓` | Shrink Selection |
| `⌘⇧↑` | Move Statement Up |
| `⌘⇧↓` | Move Statement Down |
| `⌥⇧↑` | Move Line Up |
| `⌥⇧↓` | Move Line Down |
| `⌘⇧U` | Toggle Case |
| `⌘⇧⏎` | Complete Statement |
| `⌥⏎` | Show Context Actions |
| `⌘⇧V` | Paste from History |
| `⌘J` | Insert Live Template |

## Code Intelligence

Press ⌃Space multiple times for more suggestions.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃Space` | Basic Completion |
| `⌃⇧Space` | Smart Completion |
| `⌘P` | Parameter Info |
| `⌃J` | Quick Documentation |
| `⌘F12` | File Structure |
| `⌥F7` | Find Usages |
| `⌘⌥F7` | Show Usages |
| `⇧⌘F7` | Highlight Usages in File |

## Refactoring

Select code or place cursor on symbol first.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃T` | Refactor This |
| `⇧F6` | Rename |
| `⌘⌥V` | Extract Variable |
| `⌘⌥M` | Extract Method |
| `⌘⌥C` | Extract Constant |
| `⌘⌥F` | Extract Field |
| `⌘⌥P` | Extract Parameter |
| `F6` | Move |
| `F5` | Copy |

The full [`webstorm.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/webstorm.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
